name: demo_balance
description: Log in with the given username and password, open Accounts Overview, and read the balance of the given account into an output named balance

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open Accounts Overview, and read the balance of the given account into an output named balance

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied username and password
steps.action: On the entry page, locate the Customer Login form. Enter the value of 'username' into the username input field [e9] and the value of 'password' into the password input field [e10], then click the 'Log In' button [e11].
After successful login, locate and click the 'Accounts Overview' link in the post-login navigation menu.

steps.intent: Read the balance of the specified account
steps.action: On the Accounts Overview page, find the row corresponding to 'account_id' and read the displayed balance value into the output named 'balance'.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to the banking application.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to the banking application.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account number whose balance is to be read from the Accounts Overview page.

approved_plan.success_signal: The Accounts Overview page is displayed, showing a table of accounts with their balances, confirming the account lookup completed successfully.
